title: Sindh Information Technology Board Amendment Act 2004

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Information Technology Board Amendment Act 2004
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XII OF 2004
ACT XII OF 2004
SINDH INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY BOARD (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2004
An Act to amend
the Sindh Information Technology Board Ordinance, 2002
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 12th October, 2004]
No.PAS/LEGIS‑B‑2/2004,
dated 11‑10‑2004.‑‑The Sindh Information Technology
Board (Amendment) Bill, 2004 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of
Sindh on 18th August, 2004 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 6th
October, 2004, is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.‑‑Whereas
it is expedient to amend the Sindh Information Technology Board Ordinance,
2002, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑‑(1) This Act may be called the Sindh
Information Technology Board (Amendment) Act, 2004.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

[Gazette of Sindh,

No.PAS/LEGIS‑B‑2/2004,
dated 11‑10‑2004.‑‑The Sindh Information Technology
Board (Amendment) Bill, 2004 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of
Sindh on 18th August, 2004 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 6th
October, 2004, is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.‑‑Whereas
it is expedient to amend the Sindh Information Technology Board Ordinance,
2002, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 2 of
Sindh Ordinance No.III of 2002.‑‑In the Sindh Information
Technology Board Ordinance, 2002, hereinafter referred to as the said
Ordinance, in section 2‑‑
(i) after clause
(c) the following new clause shall be inserted:‑‑
"(cc)
`Member' means a Member of the Board";
(ii) in clause
(f), the full stop at the end shall be replaced by a semi colon and thereafter
the following new clause shall be added:‑‑
"(g) `Vice‑Chairperson'
means she Vice‑Chairperson of the Board."

It is hereby enacted as follows:‑‑
3. Amendment of section 4 of
Sindh Ordinance No.III of 2002.--‑ In the said Ordinance, in section
4, for subsection (1), the following shall be substituted:‑‑
"(1) The Board shall consist
of‑‑
(i)
Governor of Sindh
Chairperson
(ii)
Minister of Information
Technology or in his absence any person nominated by the Chief Minister

(iii)
Eleven members at least five of
whom shall be from private sector to be appointed by Government."
